The game will be [b]FREE[/b], so get ready for its release by heading over to the Steam Page and adding it to your Wishlist!

notes.title: The MOST SPECIAL update to the DEMO EVER! (Also 1,000 Subscribers on Youtube).
notes.content:
In celebration of a new demo and 1,000 subscribers on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@cattrigger_games]Youtube[/url], I would like to announce the most special of all special updates to the demo and the upcoming full game of "Date Time".

That's right...

[previewyoutube=I6YtlWKLotE;full][/previewyoutube]

iiiiiit's a GAME CURSOR!

The ultimate addition to "Date Time", a GAME CURSOR reminiscient of the Classic Mac OS.  This has been a long time coming, I have spent a gazillion hours trying to figure out how to do this via code or hacking or telepathy... but then realized all I had to do was drag 'n' drop an image into the 'cursor' box in Unity.  



[b]Oh... also some fixes:[/b]


[b]Version 2.1b:
[/b]


-Reworked text printers to be completely static to prevent text jittering, rapid unintentional skipping or artifacting.  If you're still having problems, please contact me at https://www.cattrigger.com/links.


-Solved bug where players who go to Petya before completing the Melissa Chapter would come upon a black screen when returning to Petya.


-FIxed a graphical error near the end of the Anna Chapter Preview where a graphic that changed, flashes back to its initial state for a brief moment.

notes.title: Date Time Demo v2.1 Changelog - Small Fixes,
notes.content:
Thanks again for everyone who has played the Date Time Demo, so far.  Here are a few fixes due to player feedback:

[h2]Date Time Demo v2.1[/h2]

[b]1 - Standardized Text to prevent breaking text printers in the game.  [/b]

If you are still experiencing odd text printer errors, such as screens auto-skipping text, text seemingly being cut-off from the screen, or text seeming like excerpts being the only things shown on the screen, please delete your save profiles at:

WINDOWS: 

C:\Users\[Your Name]\AppData\LocalLow\CatTrigger\Date Time Demo

MAC:

~/Library/Application Support/com.CatTrigger.Date-Time-Demo

LINUX:

.config/unity3d/CatTrigger/Date Time Demo

[b]2 - Fixed an error where visiting PETya before completing the Melissa chapter leads to a black screen when re-entering PETya's section.[/b]

Please let me know if there are any other errors you might've bumped into.  Thank you so much!

[i]NOTE:

As reported by some Mac Users via the Non-Steam version of the Demo, please check your app security settings to make sure it allows for unauthorized or non-app store related applications to run.

If you are still unsure how to do it, please use Steam to download the Mac version.  [/i]

notes.title: Newest Date Time Demo - Coming out Next Week.
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GLLvhsc.png[/img]

With most of the beta testing done, the [b]Date Time Part-2 Demo[/b] will be released late next week for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2313010/Date_Time_Melissa_Morris_Anna/]Steam [/url][url=https://www.cattrigger.com/newsletter](with it being a bit earlier for subscribers of the Newsletter).[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0M0uRQ5.png[/img]

[h2]What to expect?[/h2]

You've been given the task to beta test a new chapter of "Date Time", which takes advantage of the [b]DT-3s NEW UPGRADED 6KB OF RAM!!!![/b]

Explore the town, make some friends, and complete quests to strengthen the BOUNDS of your friendships as well as sew the warm sweater of [b]your romantic relationship with the chapter's titular ANNA![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MuzdwU9.png[/img]

As "Date Time" crosses into the realm of [b]Adventure[/b], so too does the [b]Real World cross into the Digital Realm...[/b]


...and also... [b]a more insidious place. [/b]Where the hell are we?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/q2FekJz.png[/img]

The story's demo will bring a full circle to the somewhat hidden alt-path update. 

Because once your date with ANNA is done...

...Return back to the library, and enact a final DATE with MELISSA.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XFHSBnm.png[/img]

[h2]But wait!  There's more![/h2]

A very familiar security protocol has shown up in the main menu.

PETya is here to offer you guidance, information and even REAL WORLD information about the COMPUTER VIRUSES each major character is inspired by.

[b]But...[/b] they won't give the information to ANYBODY! [b] ONLY REAL LIVE HUMANS.[/b]

If you truly are human, I'm sure you'll pass with FLYING COLORS!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oZ568WW.png[/img]

[b]The Part 2 Demo [/b]was a long journey for "Date Time" development, and reveals the larger scope to expect for the full project.  With approx. an additional hour of content and a heavy emphasis on exploration, you'll take a small look into the larger world planned for the project.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2313010/Date_Time_Melissa_Morris_Anna/]I hope you enjoy it.  Don't forget to Add 'Date Time' to your Steam Wishlists![/url]



Thanks again for sticking with me, I'm excited! 



I hope to get the release to [url=https://www.cattrigger.com/newsletter]Newsletter subscribers [/url]by Wednesday, and to Itch.io and Steam on Thursday.

notes.title: A Little Bit about ANNA❤️
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ytK3Ik4.png[/img][u][/u]
[h1]Things are going to be a bit different now....[/h1]
[b]Hello everyone, this is [u]CatTrigger[/u]! [/b]

[b]Today, I want to talk a bit about what to expect with "Anna"[/b], and a small preview of the next and (possibly)[b] final major demo update.[/b]
[h1]Is There a Life Outside DATING?![/h1][img]https://i.imgur.com/N8OoK0m.gif[/img]

Unlike other chapters where your sole interaction is with the choices given through the computer, [b]this chapter introduces several key 'point 'n' click' exploration sequences.[/b]

This includes exploring your environment outside of the computer[b],[/b] and traveling around more open-endedly within the small idyllic town of "Date Time".

The ability to explore outside of character interactions is the unique play-style of the Anna chapter, and makes it the largest and longest part of the game, [b]allowing people to not only investigate the world of "Date Time" and "the Real World" at some of their discretion, but also unravel some story and secrets non-linearly.[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/e2Iq6r4.gif[/img][u][/u]
[u]The "Town Map" of Date Time, where players travel from one area to another by their own discretion.[/u]

[u][/u]
[h1]Details about Anna, Post-Demo.[/h1]
In the first part of Anna, you take on the role of a woman by the name of [b]Jane Whitman, [/b]a pivotal character who connects the thread between all the chapters.  

[b]However, the chapter's bulk story has you resuming the perspective of yet ANOTHER Library Patron, excited to try out the newest installment of the "Date Time Series".[/b]

I'll have more information as production ramps up for this chapter.

I'll leave you with this about THAT part of the chapter: you WILL be able to LEAVE THE LIBRARY.  ;)

[u][/u][u][/u]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/npmL87T.png[/img]



[h1]Some personal thoughts about development...[/h1]
(Apologies to the long windedness...)

I've mentioned before that I try to introduce something new to every new game project I do. 

Anna's exploration system is the most ambitious, and most challenging element yet for me.  It [u](and the chapter after it)[/u] will represent the largest part of "Date Time".  Period.  So people coming in from playing classic "Melissa" & "Morris" take note: [b]this will dwarf both chapters put together.[/b]

However...

"Anna" and the additional chapter after it presents a new type of problem for me that has required me to do a ton of underlying system work to ensure that as this project grows, it doesn't begin to lead to larger organizational and systemic problems.

I expected a number of issues when scaling a project from something that someone can play through in less than an hour, to something significantly longer.  But ultimately, I found that scaling by that amount can lead to NEW and previously unforeseen ones as well.




[img]https://i.imgur.com/lpjkmAM.png[/img]


[u]Picture: A Script Graphed Section of the "Jane Whitman" part of Anna.  [/u][u]Not Pictured: My tears.[/u]



That's actually led me to the type of pivots I had made throughout the demo updates. [url=https://cattrigger.itch.io/date-time/devlog/563738/demo-update-tweakin-the-road-map]The MERGE Update[/url], and the slower production cycle of the Anna updates as well.

It's also led me to think a bit about my limited resources in the project as production of new content resumes.

I have always been an independent game developer in this space, filling all the roles of writing, code and art in all of my games (the exceptions, of course, is music and the occasional voice lines).I've spoken about this dynamic a bit on [url=https://twitter.com/cattrigger/]my twitter (X?!) account [/url]about the freedom it grants me compared to other game developers who DO rely on outside Artists or Coders to help them through a project... but it also ultimately means that production is brutally slower compared to my counterparts.It may reach a point where I may hire someone to do editing, or take on a smaller role to fill in some gaps of production... or maybe it will lead me to optimize workflow in ways to avoid brutal amounts of repetitive work. 

The Story of "Date Time" has been set in stone, its outline has been written, and my plan moving forward with it is set. But as development continues, the path may have to flex in ways I didn't expect.

I hope you are all patient with me through this process and if you have any questions on what I am doing on this end, please feel free to reach out about it as I continue down this production line.

Thanks again for sticking by me.

~CatTrigger

notes.title: MELISSA ALT-PATH & How to access it
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/el6euZT.png[/img]

Hi Everyone!

I'm excited to share the newest update to the "Date Time" demo, which includes a new intro sequence, custom made menu music... oh... also an entire ALTERNATIVE PATH for the Melissa Chapter.

[b]About the "Melissa Alt-Path"[/b]

"Melissa Alt-Path" is a preview of a midpoint chapter of the full "Date Time" game, and for people who have been following the game series, is the connecting path between Melissa & Morris as well as an introduction to some of the elements expected in the Anna chapter.

This is the first part of Part-2 (that will include more new content), and can only currently be accessed by using knowledge outside of the game itself. 

In the future, the entrance to the Melissa Alt-Path will be unlocked automatically once a player gets to a certain point in the story. 

[b]However, for now, here are the two ways to access it.  First you need to download the latest version of "Date Time" demo, and then:[/b]

1.  [url=https://www.cattrigger.com/newsletter]Sign up for the CatTrigger Newsletter[/url], you will receive a welcome email that has a link for you to download free digital wallpapers, as well as instructions on how to access the Melissa Alt-Path.

or...

2.  Accomplish the login puzzle for the game [url=https://cattrigger.itch.io/dr-brain]"Secrets to Success with Dr. Brain"[/url].  Entering the secret login word inside that game will take you to a page, with some additional "Date Time" lore, as well as instructions on how to access the Melissa Alt-Path.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IUCCS8s.png[/img]

I hope you enjoy a small part of the Part-2 Demo.  Have a happy holiday!

notes.title: Upcoming Demo Update - Anna / Melissa Alt-Path
notes.content:
[h1][b]Thank you for playing Part 1 of the Date Time❤️ demo.[/b][/h1]
Over 5,000 downloads and counting! 

Wow!    [b]Melissa [/b]was SO THRILLED to have another go, a new upgrade to her systems and the ability to play with her new toys. Think of this enhanced version as the expectation going forward for both dates with [b]Morris & Anna.[/b] 




[b] Speaking of Anna...[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bQZ7hew.png[/img]

[b]Let's talk a bit about the upcoming demo update.[/b]



You've dated the bookish [b]Melissa[/b]... and maybe even the shy [b]Morris[/b]. But [b]Anna [/b]is a different person from both.

She's outgoing. She's confident. And she'll do everything possible to [b]get what she wants[/b].

[b]Anna [/b]brings forth a [b]dating adventure[/b] that eclipses both Morris & Melissa in [b]length, intrigue, and challenge.[/b]



[img]https://i.imgur.com/RA4ZaDE.png[/img]

Explore the ever growing idyllic town of Date Time❤. You're not just going to the park to look for swans, or eating a delicious strawberry salad at the cafe. You've got [b]places to go, people to see... and quests to complete[/b] to help build your friendships with the town folk.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cA1aqZW.jpg[/img]



Meet with the local sports enthusiasts at the [b]Recreational Center[/b], talk politics with the Mayor of the town at [b]City Hall[/b], and if your car's broken, get it repaired at [url=https://i.imgur.com/dNif0ML.png][ENTITY NOT FOUND][/url]

But, at the end of the day, you'll be meeting up with Anna at the overlook of the town: [b]MT. SALVATION[/b].

If you play your cards right, she'll give you an [b]eternal smooch[/b], a final end to this beautiful trilogy of ours!

Anna will capture your heart in ways Morris... or even Melissa... CAN'T.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TFwu8Rr.png[/img]

[u][/u]
[h3]Speaking of Melissa...[/h3]
...we've heard you. You want [b]a different ending.[/b] Maybe an [b]even happier one[/b] with our original ol' shareware gal?

Don't worry. You will. 

A [b][VERY IMPORTANT PERSON][/b] is going to help you with that, don't be nervous. We can do it together.

I have [b]FAITH.[/b]


[h1][url=https://www.cattrigger.com/newsletter]Get these updates earlier along with a FREE desktop wallpaper and more goodies by signing up to the Newsletter.[/url][/h1]
